findings.title: Performance NFR lacks the required load test and CI gate
findings.description: Slice D2 restates a sub-second detection NFR. The task file explicitly excludes load testing, but the review requirements require a task adding coverage under `tests/load/` and an explicit CI gating task. Add both; the cap unit tests alone do not satisfy that requirement.

findings.title: Commit checkpoints are modeled as checkbox tasks
findings.description: Task 2C and the subsequent `*C` entries make commits standalone checklist tasks rather than plain `**Commit**:` markers. Replace these entries with markers at the existing tested checkpoints. This also removes unnecessary task fragmentation without changing implementation scope.

findings.title: Renderer tests omit required outcomes
findings.description: The slice’s technical success criteria require renderer tests for every outcome. Task 8T lists brownfield, adoption-in-progress and explicit-instruction outcomes, but omits greenfield, already-planned and adoption-closed. Add those cases, including both closed states, to verify their outcome/reason and state rendering.

findings.title: Write-failure test does not verify unchanged state
findings.description: The slice explicitly requires D9 write-failure coverage asserting both `AdoptionError` and unchanged state. Task 9T only checks the error message. Capture the original configuration and assert that the failed build leaves it unchanged.
